blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) is evolving beyond conventional detection and localization toward multimodal inspection systems that can describe, explain, and reason about fine-grained defects. Although recent multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based methods improve anomaly understanding through textual reasoning and visual guidance, they face two limitations in fine-grained inspection. First, their visual refinement often requires iteratively revisiting local image regions or augmenting with additional tools. Second, the resulting local defect evidence may not be reliably preserved throughout subsequent reasoning. To address these, we propose Anomaly-LR, a defect-grounded latent reasoning framework that first forms a global understanding of the input and then progressively refines anomaly-relevant representations directly in the visual latent space. We further construct IAD-LR-22K, the first IAD instruction dataset designed for latent reasoning, containing 22,228 image-question instances from 4,523 industrial images, with global textual reasoning traces and region-level visual annotations. Extensive experiments show that Anomaly-LR achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable-scale methods across multiple IAD benchmarks, without requiring external references or tools. The code and data will be released at https://github.com/Yen666/Anomaly-LR .
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测正在超越常规检测和本地化,转向能够描述、解释和解释精细缺陷的多式联运检查系统。 虽然最近的基于多模式的大型语言模型(MLLM)方法通过文字推理和视觉指导提高了反常理解,但它们在精细的检查中面临两个限制. 首先,它们的视觉改进往往需要反复地重新审视当地图像区域或增加其他工具。 其次,由此产生的当地缺陷证据可能无法在其后的整个推理过程中得到可靠保存。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用异常-LR这一基于缺陷的潜在推理框架,首先形成对投入的全球理解,然后逐步完善视觉潜在空间中与异常有关的表述。 我们进一步构建了IAD-LR-22K,这是第一个IAD指令数据集,为潜在推理设计,包含来自4,523个工业图像的22,228个图像问题实例,并带有全球文字推理痕迹和区域一级的视觉说明. 广泛的实验表明,异常-LR在跨多个内审司基准的可比尺度方法中实现最新性能,而不需要外部参考或工具。 该代码和数据将在https://github.com/Yen666/Anomaly-LR上发布。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) is a critical component of manufacturing quality control, traditionally formulated as detecting anomalous samples and localizing defective regions. Convolutional network-based methods mainly produce anomaly scores or localization maps, offering limited semantic interpretation [ 17 , 27 , 21 ] . The emergence of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 20 , 12 , 3 ] has broadened industrial inspection toward more comprehensive understanding, enabling anomaly discrimination, localization, text description, and deeper analysis [ 8 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测是制造业质量控制的重要组成部分,传统上是用来检测异常样本和将缺陷区域本地化。 基于革命网络的方法主要产生异常分数或本地化地图,提供有限的语义解释[17,27,21]. 多式联运大语言模型[20、12、3]的出现,扩大了工业检查范围,使人们更加全面地了解,导致异常歧视、本地化、文字描述和深入分析[8、26]。

blocks.en: Building on this shift, recent advances introduce increasingly sophisticated reasoning mechanisms for fine-grained defect inspection. IAD-R1 [ 18 ] enhances textual reasoning through chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning. AgentIAD [ 22 ] iteratively revisits suspicious regions through external agentic tools. Reason-IAD [ 6 ] performs iterative latent optimization with a dynamic visual injection mechanism. Although these approaches strengthen anomaly reasoning from different perspectives, several limitations remain. Text-based reasoning provides only an indirect means of capturing fine-grained visual details, while visual refinement based on region revisiting or external visual tools introduces extra inspection steps. Moreover, the resulting local defect evidence may not always be effectively preserved and utilized throughout subsequent reasoning, as providing additional visual inputs does not necessarily guarantee that the model will attend to and exploit the relevant information [ 10 , 16 ] . This raises the question of whether anomaly reasoning can reduce reliance on repeated visual intervention while more directly incorporating localized defect evidence into the reasoning process.
blocks.zh: 在这一转变的基础上,最近的进展为精细缺陷检查引入了日益复杂的推理机制。 IAD-R1[18]通过思维链式监督和强化学习加强文字推理. AgentIAD [22] 通过外部代理工具反复重访可疑区域. 理性-IAD [6] 以动态视觉注射机制进行迭代潜伏优化. 虽然这些办法从不同角度加强了反常推理,但仍有一些局限性。 基于文字的推理只提供了一种捕捉精细的视觉细节的间接手段,而基于区域重访或外部视觉工具的视觉修饰则引入了额外的检查步骤. 此外,由此产生的当地缺陷证据可能并不总是在其后的整个推理过程中得到有效保存和利用,因为提供额外的视觉投入不一定保证模型将注意和利用有关信息[10,16]。 这提出了一个问题,即异常推理是否能够减少对重复视觉干预的依赖,同时更直接地将局部缺陷证据纳入推理过程.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose Anomaly-LR, a defect-grounded latent reasoning framework that internalizes localized visual refinement within the model’s latent space. Guided by textual global understanding, Anomaly-LR progressively refines intermediate hidden states by aligning them with defect-relevant visual features before answer generation. This design establishes a global-to-local reasoning process without repeated region revisiting or reliance on external tools. To train Anomaly-LR, we further construct IAD-LR-22K, the first IAD instruction dataset designed for latent reasoning, consisting of 22,228 image-question instances from 4,523 industrial images, with global textual reasoning traces and region-level visual annotations.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出Anomaly-LR, 一个基于缺陷的潜伏推理框架, 将本地化的视觉精细化到模型的潜在空间中。 在文字全局理解的指导下,Anomaly-LR在解答生成前,通过将中间隐藏状态与与缺陷相关的视觉特征对齐,逐渐完善中间隐藏状态. 这一设计确立了一个从全球到地方的推理过程,不重复区域重新审视或依赖外部工具. 为了训练Anomaly-LR,我们进一步构建了IAD-LR-22K,这是第一个IAD指令数据集,为潜伏推理设计,由来自4,523个工业图像的22,228个图像问题实例组成,并带有全球文字推理痕迹和区域一级的视觉说明.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Anomaly-LR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches at both 3B and 7B model scales, while maintaining these gains under cross-dataset evaluation. In addition, attention map analysis shows that Anomaly-LR concentrates substantially more attention within defect regions, supporting its effectiveness in defect-grounded reasoning. This is achieved without requiring auxiliary reference images, information, or tools. We have made the Anomaly-LR model and IAD-LR-22K dataset publicly available to support future research in IAD.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,异常-LR在3B和7B模型尺度上一直优于最新方法,同时在跨数据集评价下保持这些收益。 此外,注意力图分析显示,异常-LR将更多的注意力集中在缺陷区域,支持其在基于缺陷的推理中的有效性. 这是在不需要辅助参考图像、信息或工具的情况下实现的。 我们公开提供了异常-LR模型和IAD-LR-22K数据集,以支持未来在IAD的研究.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are summarized as follows.
(1) We propose Anomaly-LR, a defect-grounded latent reasoning framework that internalizes localized visual refinement within the model’s latent space.
(2) We construct IAD-LR-22K, the first IAD instruction dataset designed for latent reasoning, with global textual reasoning traces and region-level visual annotations.
(3) Experiments and attention analysis validate Anomaly-LR’s effectiveness in defect-grounded reasoning without external reference images, information, or tools.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献概述如下。
(1) 我们提出异常-LR,这是一个基于缺陷的潜在推理框架,将模型潜在空间内的局部视觉精细化。
(2) 我们构建IAD-LR-22K,这是第一个IAD指令数据集,为潜伏推理设计,带有全球文字推理痕迹和地区级视觉说明.
(3)实验和注意力分析验证了异常-LR在没有外部参考图像、信息或工具的情况下基于缺陷的推理的有效性。

Its defect-grounded reasoning process consists of three phases: global textual reasoning, N N steps of local latent visual reasoning delimited by the <lvr_start> and <lvr_end> tokens, and final answer generation. At training time, the latent positions are supervised to reconstruct the visual embeddings of the annotated defect region. At inference time, the model feeds its own hidden states back for K K steps.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: This section introduces defect-grounded latent supervision. We supervise the intermediate states of an MLLM using visual tokens from annotated defect regions and global textual reasoning traces.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍基于缺陷的潜在监督。 我们利用注解缺陷区域的视觉信号 和全球文字推理痕迹 监督MLLM的中间状态

blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 总体结构

blocks.en: The global textual reasoning phase first forms a concise natural-language understanding of the entire image, after which the local latent visual reasoning phase examines suspicious regions. This global-to-local reasoning follows the natural inspection process of first identifying the object and its overall condition, and then investigating potentially defective areas [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 全球文字推理阶段首先形成对整个图像的简明自然语言理解,之后当地潜在的视觉推理阶段对可疑区域进行考察. 这种从全球到地方的推理遵循自然检查过程,首先确定物体及其总体状况,然后调查潜在的缺陷领域[26]。

blocks.en: Inspired by [ 16 ] , the local latent visual reasoning phase uses positions without explicit token identities and is directly supervised with visual embeddings from the annotated defect region. This encourages the model to reconstruct localized visual evidence in the latent space. The number of latent positions is determined by the size of the defect region, allowing larger defects to receive more positions for reconstruction. The final phase derives the answer from the preceding global textual and local latent visual reasoning states.
blocks.zh: 在[16]的启发下,当地潜伏的视觉推理阶段使用没有明显标志性身份的姿势,并直接通过来自注释缺陷区域的视觉嵌入来监督. 这鼓励模型在潜在空间重建局部视觉证据. 潜在位置的数量由缺陷区域的规模决定,允许较大的缺陷得到更多的位置进行重建. 最后阶段的答案来自先前的全球文字和本地潜在视觉推理。

blocks.en: During inference, no annotations are available, so the latent segment is generated autoregressively. After emitting the <|lvr_start|> token, the model feeds its own hidden state back as the next input embedding for K K steps before resuming textual decoding (see Fig. 1 ). We employ the fixed-budget decoding strategy, which was reported to outperform both a learned stopping token and an auxiliary mode-switching objective [ 16 ] .

blocks.en: 2.3 IAD-LR-22K dataset
blocks.zh: 2.3 IAD-LR-22K数据集

blocks.en: Existing IAD instruction datasets primarily supervise textual predictions and reasoning processes [ 26 , 18 , 15 ] . To our knowledge, none provides annotations that explicitly ground intermediate latent representations in localized defect evidence. To enable defect-grounded latent supervision, we construct IAD-LR-22K, the first IAD instruction dataset designed for latent reasoning. It contains 22,228 image-question instances derived from 4,523 industrial images sourced from the MMAD [ 15 ] and Real-IAD [ 24 ] datasets. For MMAD, we sample 1,600 images spanning all 38 categories, with a balanced split between normal and anomalous cases. We retain the original questions, answer choices, and ground-truth answers, yielding 7,613 image-question instances. For Real-IAD, we use 2,923 images across 30 categories and generate five MMAD-style inspection questions per image, resulting in 14,615 instances. For each instance, we construct a concise global textual reasoning trace together with a region-level visual annotation. Defect regions are derived from the existing anomaly labels, while normal images are assigned object-centric regions. We refer to the resulting MMAD and Real-IAD subsets as IAD-LR-22K-MMAD and IAD-LR-22K-RealIAD, respectively. IAD-LR-22K supports defect-grounded reasoning across a range of IAD tasks, including anomaly detection, localization, defect description, and anomaly analysis.
blocks.zh: 现有的ID指令数据集主要监督文字预测和推理过程[26,18,15]. 据我们所知,没有任何说明明确证明局部缺陷证据具有中间潜在表现。 为了实现基于缺陷的潜在监管,我们构建了IAD-LR-22K,这是第一个为潜在推理设计的IAD指令数据集. 它包含22,228个图像问题实例,来自来自MMAD[15]和Real-IAD[24]数据集的4,523个工业图像. 就MMAD而言,我们抽样了1,600幅涵盖所有38个类别的图像,在正常和异常情况之间进行了平衡的划分。 我们保留了最初的问题、答案选择和地面真相答案,产生了7 613个图像问题实例。 就Real-IAD而言,我们使用30个类别的2 923幅图像,每幅图像产生5个MMAD式检查问题,导致14 615个案例。 就每个实例而言,我们构建了一个简明的全球文字推理跟踪,以及区域一级的视觉注释。 缺陷区域来自现有的异常标签,而正常的图像则被指定为以物体为中心的区域. 我们把由此产生的MMAD和Real-IAD子集分别称为IAD-LR-22K-MMAD和IAD-LR-22K-RealIAD. IAD-LR-22K支持跨一系列IAD任务的基于缺陷推理,包括异常检测,本地化,缺陷描述,以及异常分析.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验装置

blocks.en:
Datasets and evaluation protocol. Our experiments cover both in-domain and out-of-domain (OOD) evaluations. For in-domain evaluation, we train Anomaly-LR on IAD-LR-22K-MMAD and test it on the remaining MMAD [ 15 ] data, comprising 32,059 multiple-choice questions from 6,766 images. The training and test sets are disjoint, with an approximate 20%/80% split. This setting follows the evaluation protocol adopted in recent advances [ 22 , 28 , 19 ] . MMAD assesses seven subtasks via multiple-choice questions: Anomaly Discrimination, Defect Classification, Defect Localization, Defect Description, Defect Analysis, Object
Classification, and Object Analysis. Accuracy is used as the metric. For OOD evaluation, we train Anomaly-LR on IAD-LR-22K-RealIAD and test it on six OOD benchmarks, including MVTec [ 4 ] , MPDD [ 13 ] , VisA [ 29 ] , DAGM [ 25 ] , DTD [ 2 ] , and SDD [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh:
数据集与评价协议. 我们的实验既包括域内评价也包括域外评价。 为了进行域内评价,我们在IAD-LR-22K-MMAD上对Anomaly-LR进行训练,并在剩余的MMAD[15]数据上测试,包括来自6,766图像的32,059个多选题. 培训与测试机组脱节,大约20%/80%分开。 这一设定遵循了最近进展中通过的评价协议[22、28、19]。 MMAD通过多个选择问题评估七个子任务: 异常歧视、缺陷分类、缺陷本地化、缺陷描述、缺陷分析、对象
分类和对象分析。 精确度作为衡量标准。 为了进行OOD评价,我们用IAD-LR-22K-RealIAD对Anomaly-LR进行训练,并以6个OOD基准进行测试,包括MVTec [4],MPDD [13],VisA [29],DAGM [25],DTD [2]和SDD [23].

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare our Anomaly-LR with human reference, general-purpose MLLMs [ 12 , 3 ] , and nine state-of-the-art MLLM-based IAD methods [ 8 , 22 , 6 , 5 , 28 , 9 , 19 , 14 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较我们的异常-LR与人类参考、通用的MLLMs[12,3],以及9种最先进的基于MLLM的IAD方法[8,22,6,5,28,9,19,14,7].

blocks.en: Implementation details. We adopt Qwen2.5-VL [ 3 ] 3B and 7B as the MLLM backbones for Anomaly-LR. We train both models for three epochs with random seed 42, a batch size of 8, weight decay of 0.1, and λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , using a cosine learning-rate schedule with 3% warmup. The learning rate is set to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for the 3B model and 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for the 7B model. We use at most 5,120 visual tokens per image during training. At inference time, we follow the official MMAD configuration, using at most 1,280 visual tokens per image. We decode greedily with a maximum of 320 new tokens and set the number of latent reasoning steps to K = 8 K=8 .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 我们采用Quen2.5-VL[3]3B和7B作为异常-LR的MLLM骨干. 我们为三个纪元训练两种模式,随机种子42,批量大小8,重量衰减0.1,以及QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1,采用同位素学习率表,热量为3%. 3B模型的学习率定为1×10−5 1\times 10×5}7B模型的学习率定为5×10−6 5\times 10×6). 在训练期间,每个图像最多使用5 120个视觉标志。 推算时,我们遵循MMAD的官方配置,每个图像最多使用1,280个视觉符号. 我们贪婪地解码了最多320个新符牌,并将潜在推理步骤的数量设定为K=8K=8.

blocks.en: 3.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: In-domain evaluation. Table 1 reports per-subtask accuracy on MMAD. Anomaly-LR with both 3B and 7B backbones achieves the highest average accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our 3B model surpasses all 7B and 8B competitors, as well as substantially larger general-purpose MLLMs, while our 7B model achieves the best accuracy across all seven subtasks. Several strong baselines, including AgentIAD [ 22 ] , AD-FM [ 19 ] , and OmniAD [ 28 ] , adopt the same protocol of the 20%/80% MMAD train/test split as ours, making their results directly comparable. In addition, many methods rely on auxiliary reference images, domain information, or external tools, whereas Anomaly-LR requires neither.
blocks.zh: 域内评价. 表1汇报了每个次级任务的准确性。 具有3B和7B两个主干线的异常-LR实现最高平均精度,优于最先进的方法. 值得注意的是,我们的3B模型超越了所有7B和8B竞争对手,以及相当大的通用MLLMs,而我们的7B模型在所有七个子任务中都达到了最佳的精确度. 一些强基线,包括AgentIAD [22],AD-FM [19],和OmniAD [28],采用了与我们相同的20%/80%MMAD列车/测试拆分的协议,使其结果直接可比. 此外,许多方法都依赖于辅助参考图像,域信息,或外部工具,而Anomaly-LR则不需要.

blocks.en: Table 2: OOD evaluation on six IAD benchmarks: MVTec [ 4 ] , MPDD [ 13 ] , VisA [ 29 ] , DAGM [ 25 ] , DTD [ 2 ] , and SDD [ 23 ] . Results are reported in terms of balanced accuracy, following IAD-R1 [ 18 ] . Bold denotes the best value and underline denotes the second-best value.
blocks.zh: 表2:对6个内审司基准进行OD评价:MVTec[4]、MPDD[13]、VisA[29]、DAGM[25]、DTD[2]和SDD[23]。 根据IAD-R1[18]报告结果的准确性。 粗体表示最佳价值,下划线表示第二最佳价值。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation results on the MMAD dataset [ 15 ] . All models are trained using the same protocol.
blocks.zh: 表3: MMAD数据集的偏差结果 [15]. 所有型号都使用相同的协议进行训练.

blocks.en: OOD evaluation. Table 2 reports the OOD evaluation results. IAD-R1 [ 18 ] uses the same Qwen2.5-VL backbone and Real-IAD [ 24 ] training images as Anomaly-LR, making it directly comparable. Anomaly-LR improves the average accuracy from 77.4% to 79.0% at the 3B scale and from 80.4% to 82.2% at the 7B scale, achieving state-of-the-art performance. These results show the cross-dataset generalizability of the proposed defect-grounded latent reasoning framework.
blocks.zh: OD评价. 表2报告了OD的评价结果。 IAD-R1 [18] 使用相同的Quen2.5-VL主干线和Real-IAD [24] 训练图像作为Anomaly-LR,使其直接具有可比性. 异常-LR在3B级中平均精度从77.4%提高到79.0%,在7B级中平均精度从80.4%提高到82.2%,实现了最先进的性能. 这些结果表明,拟议的基于缺陷的潜在推理框架具有跨数据集的通用性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Architecture design. Table 3 a compares different architectural variants on MMAD [ 15 ] under the in-domain evaluation setting. The Phase 1 + Phase 3 variant removes the local latent visual reasoning stage and is trained only with ℒ CE {\cal L}_{\text{CE}} , making it analogous to standard text-based supervised fine-tuning. The Phase 2 + Phase 3 variant retains local latent visual reasoning but removes the global textual reasoning stage, making it similar to [ 16 ] . The full three-phase architecture achieves the best performance. In particular, Phase 2 + Phase 3 tends to collapse to a single answer because the answer span is short and its cross-entropy loss saturates early during training. These results show that global textual reasoning and local latent visual reasoning are both effective and complementary.
blocks.zh: 建筑设计. 表3 a比较了域内评价设置下MMAD[15]上不同的建筑变体. Phase 1 + Phase 3 变体取消了本地潜在的视觉推理阶段,只接受了 L CE \cal LQQText{CE}}]的训练,使其类似于标准的文本监督微调. Phase 2 + Phase 3的变体保留了局部潜在的视觉推理,但删除了全局文字推理阶段,使其与[16]相似. 完整的三阶段建筑实现最佳性能. 特别是第2阶段+第3阶段往往会崩溃为单一的答案,因为答案跨度很短,而且其跨直径损失在训练中很早就饱和. 这些结果表明,全球文字推理和地方潜在视觉推理既有效又相辅相成。

blocks.en: Latent reconstruction loss. Table 3 b compares different objectives for the latent reconstruction loss ℒ recon {\cal L}_{\text{recon}} . Cosine similarity outperforms the L 2 L_{2} loss used in [ 16 ] at the 3B scale and performs comparably at the 7B scale. We attribute this to the scale mismatch between the latent hidden states and target visual embeddings. The L 2 L_{2} loss is sensitive to differences in magnitude, whereas cosine similarity focuses on their directional alignment.
blocks.zh: 初期重建损失. 表3b比较了潜在重建损失的不同目标。 余弦相似性在3B尺度上超过了[16]中使用的L2 L_{2}损失,在7B尺度上也具有可比较性. 我们将此归因于潜在隐藏状态与目标视觉嵌入之间的比例不匹配。 L2 LQQX2} 损失对大小差异很敏感,而余弦相似性则侧重于它们的方向对齐.

blocks.en: Latent budget during inference. As mentioned in Sec. 3.1 , we set K = 8 K=8 as the default number of latent reasoning steps. As shown in Table 3 c, removing the latent rollout entirely ( K = 0 K=0 ) drops the accuracy, confirming that iterative reasoning in the visual latent space contributes to the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 推论期间的追加预算。 如第3.1节所述,我们设定 K = 8 K = 8 为潜在推理步骤的默认数。 如表3c所示,完全删除潜在的推展(K = 0 K = 0)会降低准确度,确认视觉潜在空间的迭代推理有助于最终预测.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Attention maps of the models on a VisA [ 29 ] test image (candle). The green circle denotes the ground-truth defect region. Compared to the Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 3 ] backbone, Anomaly-LR-3B focuses much more strongly on the defect region.
blocks.zh: 图2:VisA[29]测试图像(烛光)上模型的注意图. 绿色圆圈表示地面真相缺陷区域. 与Quen2.5-VL-3B[3]骨干相比,Anomaly-LR-3B更注重于缺陷区域.

blocks.en: Attention map analysis. Fig. 2 visualizes the attention maps of the models on a VisA [ 29 ] test image (candle). Compared to the Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 3 ] backbone, Anomaly-LR-3B focuses much more strongly on the defect region. Following the evidence-attention diagnostic of [ 11 ] , we quantify each map by the attention mass assigned to the annotated defect region at layer ⌊ 2 ​ L / 3 ⌋ \lfloor 2L/3\rfloor , normalized by the mass that uniform attention would assign to the same region. Qwen2.5-VL-3B assigns 4.4 × 4.4\times the uniform attention mass to the defect region, whereas Anomaly-LR-3B reaches 19.5 × 19.5\times . These results demonstrate that the proposed defect-grounded latent reasoning more effectively directs the model’s attention toward localized defect evidence.
blocks.zh: 注意地图分析 图2在VisA[29]测试图像(烛光)上可视化模型的注意力图. 与Quen2.5-VL-3B[3]骨干相比,Anomaly-LR-3B更注重于缺陷区域. 在对[11]进行证据观察诊断后,我们将每张地图量化,以2 L / 3 + llode 2L/3\rlode 的注解区分配的注意质量为单位,使同一区域得到统一注意的质量正常化。 Quen2.5-VL-3B为缺陷区域分配4.4×4.4\时的统一注意力质量,而异常-LR-3B则达到19.5×19.5\时. 这些结果表明,拟议的基于缺陷的潜在推理将更有效地引导模型的注意力转向局部缺陷证据。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Anomaly-LR, a defect-grounded latent reasoning framework that internalizes localized visual refinement within the model’s latent space, and IAD-LR-22K, the first IAD dataset designed for latent reasoning. Guided by global textual reasoning, Anomaly-LR progressively refines intermediate hidden states by aligning them with defect-relevant visual features. This design reduces reliance on repeated visual intervention. Anomaly-LR achieves strong performance across model scales and benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of defect-grounded latent reasoning for fine-grained industrial anomaly understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Anomaly-LR, 一个基于缺陷的潜在推理框架, 将本地化的视觉精细化到模型的潜在空间, 和IAD-LR-22K, 第一个IAD数据集, 为潜在推理设计。 以全局文字推理为指南,Anomaly-LR通过使其与缺陷相关视觉特征相匹配,逐渐完善中间隐藏状态. 这种设计减少了对反复视觉干预的依赖. 异常-LR在模型尺度和基准之间取得了强劲的业绩,显示了基于缺陷的潜在推理对于精细的工业异常理解的有效性。

blocks.en: 5 Compliance with Ethical Standards
blocks.zh: 5 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: This study uses existing public benchmarks and collects no new human-subject data. No ethical approval was required.
blocks.zh: 这项研究使用了现有的公共基准,没有收集新的人类主体数据。 不需要道德上的批准。
